Messages.Body:
1) if you dodge or play S:CE against a First Strike, this strike does not
take effect.

2) Can you dodge a strike Ranged directed against a retainer ? even if the
combat is at close range ?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Snoop" <p_st...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> 1) if you dodge or play S:CE against a First Strike, this strike does
not
> take effect.

If you play S:CE, then combat ends before the other strike begins to
resolve.
If you dodge, then the effects of the other strike on you (the Dodger)
are cancelled.

> 2) Can you dodge a strike Ranged directed against a retainer ?

No. (Well, you can dodge, but your Retainers are not protected by the
dodge.)

> even if the
> combat is at close range ?

Retainers cannot be targetted at close range.
